name: Easy 4-Ingredient Banana, Peanut Butter & Oatmeal Cookies with Chocolate Chips

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Place bananas in a medium bowl and mash with a fork or potato masher.

Add oats, peanut butter, and chocolate chips to the bowl with the mashed banana, then stir well to combine. Use a measuring cup or cookie scoop to portion out the dough on the baking sheet, about a ¼-cup for each cookie, spacing the cookies a ½-inch apart. Gently press each cookie with the bottom of a measuring cup to flatten slightly (they should be about a ½-inch thick).
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups oats, quick cooking
½ cup natural peanut butter
⅓ cup dark chocolate chips

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until cookies are golden, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. (The cookies will firm up as they cool.)
Transfer cookies to a platter, share, and enjoy!
